title: Three Springs and One Short Border
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：flower　|　正文 348 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 flower 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1961 my grandmother ① grew a flower that no gardener in the valley would have named, and she said the growing was the whole of the spring. The ② flower, meaning the bloom itself and not the plant, ran three springs and stayed unnamed in the book; a flower, she said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ flower in that garden had the same short border beside it, and the ④ flower at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A flower, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandmother said the naming is the part that fills three springs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the flower was the whole of the matter, meaning the best part and not the bloom. The ⑥ flower, meaning the best part and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; flower, he said, is either something you grow or the only word that means both a bloom and the best part. He said the best part is the part they remember.

By 1968 the ⑦ flower had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short border. The ⑧ flower of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was one valley and three springs of naming; flower, she said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. She said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ flower I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ flower, my mother said in 1972, is the only one that improves by being named; every flower, she said, is the best part that has agreed to look like a bloom. She said the best part was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 花；花朵（指园子里每一朵旁边的那一朵）
B. n. 花（指那一朵本身，与植株相对）
C. 固定搭配：grow a flower 种一朵花
D. n. 花（指留给孩子们的那一朵）
E. n. 花（抽象总称，指一个山谷的种花之事）
F. n. 花（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一朵）
G. n. 精华；最好的部分（the flower of，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 精华（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: grew a flower that no gardener in the valley would have named
The flower, meaning the bloom itself and not the plant
the flower at the far end
the flower was the whole of the matter
The flower, meaning the best part
the flower had become a line in a plan
The flower of the whole thing
A flower, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: grow a flower 意为“种一朵花”，1961 年祖母种了一朵山谷里没有一位园丁肯说出名字的花。
flower 意为“花”，指那一朵本身而不是植株，它经过了三个春天而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
flower 意为“花”，指园子里每一朵旁边的那一朵，每一朵旁边都有同一道矮矮的花坛边。
flower 意为“花”，指留给孩子们的那一朵，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
flower 意为“精华、最好的部分”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份精华就是那件事的全部。
flower 意为“精华”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那一朵花，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
flower 意为“花”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一朵，到 1968 年这一朵成了计划里的一行。
flower 意为“花”，祖母四月写道，整件事的种花之事是一个山谷和三个春天的说出名字。
flower 意为“花”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一朵，1970 年结束了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一朵。
flower 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，一朵花是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
